Data (inputs the user fills + queries that fetch data)

fields.description: Inputs the user fills at generation. Each fieldname binds into every query as a named parameter, e.g. company -> %(company)s.
fields.label: Inputs

fields.description: One or more SQL / Python sources. Each result is exposed to the document as {{ data.<source_name>.rows }} and {{ data.<source_name>.row.<column> }}.
fields.label: Data Sources

fields.options: Email renders this header/footer on every page (digital letterhead). Print (letterhead paper) leaves the same amount of blank space at top/bottom (set by the heights) but does not draw them — for printing on your pre-printed letterhead. Set the heights to match your pre-printed header/footer band. Supports Jinja; leave empty to fall back to the linked Letter Head.

fields.description: Reserved header height in mm (top page margin).
fields.label: Header Height (mm)

fields.description: Reserved footer height in mm (bottom page margin).
fields.label: Footer Height (mm)

fields.options: Write the document as HTML. Use placeholders from your data sources, e.g. {{ data.sales.row.total }} (single value) or loop rows with {% for r in data.totals.rows %}...{% endfor %}. Inputs are available as {{ inputs.company }}, plus {{ company }}, {{ today }} and {{ fmt(value) }}. Use the Preview button to see it rendered.

fields.description: The document template as raw HTML + Jinja. Rendered with your data at generation time; the user can then edit the result before printing/emailing.
fields.label: Body HTML
